mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies and 56 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, with a full moon overhead. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials are working on the 2027 budget and reviewing several land development proposals, including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans on Milky Way, which will be discussed on November 4th.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, tomorrow offers yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for the annual Main Street Trick or Treat event on October 29th.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15th where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students, though fortunately no injuries occurred.
Today's delicious flavor is Snickers Swirl and you can head over to the store when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
